inspired_by_public_product.note: Signal names reflect common public capabilities of healthcare booking platforms (online booking, reminders/no-shows, profile, reviews, support). No company-specific data or inside knowledge.

signal_glossary.last_login_days: Days since clinic staff last logged into the scheduling product (proxy for engagement).
signal_glossary.online_booking_adoption_pct: Share of appointments booked online vs total (public product emphasis: 24/7 online booking).
signal_glossary.open_tickets: Open support tickets with the vendor CSM/support team.
signal_glossary.patient_review_score: 0–100 proxy for review/reputation activity health (public product: patient reviews).
signal_glossary.profile_calendar_complete: Whether public profile + online calendar setup is complete (public product: profile + agenda).

metric_glossary.last_login_days: Days since clinic staff last logged into the scheduling product (proxy for engagement).
metric_glossary.online_booking_adoption_pct: Product: % of appointments via online booking (fictitious).
metric_glossary.open_tickets: Open support tickets with the vendor CSM/support team.
metric_glossary.profile_calendar_complete: Whether public profile + online calendar setup is complete (public product: profile + agenda).
metric_glossary.health_score: Rules-based clinic health from login, online-booking adoption, tickets, review score, profile completeness.
metric_glossary.risk_tier: Red <45 · Amber <70 · Green ≥70 · Onboarding if tenure <21d.
metric_glossary.simulated_mrr_at_risk: Red MRR only — SAMPLE/FICTITIOUS, not real protected revenue.
metric_glossary.days_to_renewal: Commercial: days until contract renewal in the demo dataset.

limitations: No live CRM credentials in this package
